edits.headline: Trump says Ukraine needs a new president who can make a deal
edits.subheadline: Trump suggested Volodymyr Zelensky had not done enough to end the war with Russia and blamed him for diesel prices, the Associated Press reported.
editorialBody: Donald Trump said it was time for Ukraine to get a new president, suggesting Volodymyr Zelensky had not done enough to end the war with Russia, the Associated Press reported. Trump also blamed Zelensky for diesel prices, the AP said.
Hurricane Isaias hit the Florida Panhandle and Alabama, leaving hundreds of thousands of people without power, News4Jax reported. Four deaths were linked to the storm, the Boston Globe reported.

Pakistan imposed emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, the province governed by Imran Khan's party, and arrested its chief minister, The Week reported. Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry said Sohail Afridi and senior PTI leaders had been taken into custody, Minute Mirror reported.
